items.title: Foundry's SmartRoto: AI-assisted roto that aims to work the way you do
items.excerpt: Foundry released SmartRoto, an AI-powered Nuke plugin that accelerates rotoscoping by automating keyframe animation while preserving artist control and precision at image edges. It targets the single most labour-heavy manual task in the VFX pipeline without taking the spline away from the artist.

items.title: Foundry Adds Griptape Enterprise for Pro-Grade AI in VFX
items.excerpt: Foundry introduced Griptape Enterprise, a licensing tier for high-end media production with studio-controlled governance, on-prem infrastructure options and security controls that keep sensitive IP inside the facility while enabling AI-integrated creative workflows.

items.title: Foundry Launches Griptape Enterprise for Secure AI-Accelerated VFX Workflows
items.excerpt: New tier adds studio-controlled licensing, project management and governance tools for high-end media production, giving pipeline supervisors control over which AI models artists use. Studios can run workflows on-premises or in private cloud to keep sensitive IP, prompts and training data inside the facility.

items.title: Latest Dalet Flex LTS Boosts AI Workflows, Deepens Dalia Integration
items.excerpt: Dalet's latest Long-Term Supported release of Dalet Flex introduces intelligent automation across the media production lifecycle, expanding AI-powered capabilities through deeper Dalia integration to streamline workflows from content acquisition through delivery.

items.title: Great ways to use Auto Mask in Final Cut Pro
items.excerpt: Auto Mask in Final Cut Pro 12.3 recognizes people, body parts, scene elements and even pets on every frame with no tracking required, opening up fast selective color correction and VFX work. A practical look at ML-driven masking replacing manual roto inside an NLE.

items.title: NFB Brings Gaussian Splatting Animation Session to SIGGRAPH
items.excerpt: Eloi Champagne and Jimmy Fournier lead a July 22 Birds of a Feather session covering Gaussian-based animation workflows, hybrid pipelines and production uses from acquisition through delivery, with examples from NFB works in progress and technical explorations with NVIDIA's Spatial Intelligence Lab and the University of Toronto's Dynamic Graphics Project.

items.title: SwitchHDR, an AI model for HDR reconstruction from SDR video
items.excerpt: Beeble's new AI model reconstructs HDR imagery from standard dynamic range video, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences in ACES2065-1 for professional post pipelines. Unlike naive SDR expansion, it is trained on real HDR footage to infer plausible high dynamic range detail.

items.title: Beeble launches SwitchHDR to reconstruct HDR from SDR footage
items.excerpt: Beeble released SwitchHDR, an AI-powered tool that reconstructs HDR video from SDR footage, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences in ACES2065-1 (AP0) for professional post-production workflows. Service starts at $16/month on pro tiers.

items.title: Beeble's SwitchHDR AI Model Turns SDR Footage Into HDR
items.excerpt: No Film School's take on Beeble's SwitchHDR, an AI model that reconstructs high dynamic range imagery from ordinary SDR video for grading and VFX work — framed for indie filmmakers rescuing legacy or clipped footage.

items.title: 'This Is a Black-and-White Issue': Jorge R. Gutierrez Says Death Threats Drove Decision to Axe His GenAI Animated Project at Amazon
items.excerpt: Director Jorge R. Gutierrez explains why he walked away from Amazon MGM's generative-AI animation initiative, describing the backlash and threats that followed the announcement. A stark read on how far the creative community's tolerance for genAI-native animation production actually extends.
